messages:
emma: Quick sync — I'm proposing a timezone-safe release for v2.16.2 next Wed. Need agreement on warmup windows, changelog freeze, and branch cutoffs. Outline below, please react or ping if you see issues.

raj: +1 for a Wednesday ship. Can we make the freeze 24h before the US canary start? keeps EU/APAC windows clean.

sophie: APAC needs a longer pre-warm (10m -> 30m) for peak shard cold starts. Also: increase canary in apac to 5% initially.

liam: infra can run prewarm jobs. I'd prefer a staggered approach so we don't spike provisioning. Example command: `./scripts/prewarm --region apac --minutes 30 --pool ci-small`

emma: OK — proposal (all times in UTC):
```
- 2026-11-10 00:00 UTC: changelog freeze (no non-critical merges)
- 2026-11-10 06:00 UTC: US pre-warm 10m, canary 2% (us-west/us-east)
- 2026-11-10 09:00 UTC: EU pre-warm 15m, canary 3% (eu-west)
- 2026-11-10 18:00 UTC: APAC pre-warm 30m, canary 5% (ap-northeast/ap-southeast)
- 2026-11-10 20:00 UTC: global ramp if metrics OK
```
Followups: rollback window 30m after each ramp, health gating on latency/error budget, qa smoke in each region before ramp.

raj: Suggest we add a branch-cutoff label: `release/v2.16.2-cutoff`. Any PRs merged after freeze need `override/release` and :eyes: from release owners.

liam: I'll schedule prewarm jobs and leave the `--dry-run` for first run, then flip to real on ack. I'll also add a short job to validate KV-cache population.

sophie: For APAC, please ensure the autoscaler min capacity is bumped +1 node for the pre-warm window. Otherwise the cold-start tail will kill the SLO.

emma: Noted — @liam can you bump min-cap for apac during pre-warm?

liam: Yep — will apply a temporary scaling override starting 30m before APAC pre-warm and remove 30m after global ramp.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `prewarm-v2.16.2` start=2026-11-10T05:30:00Z region=us-west type=canary (dry-run) — run ID: pv2162-001

raj: Who's on-call for release window? @sophie taking primary? Need a backup.

sophie: I'll be primary. @emma can you be backup for the US window?

emma: I can. Also, I'll post a short checklist in #eng-oncall 2h before start: health endpoints, burn-in traces, throttling rules.

raj: Changelog owners — please post final changelog by freeze time. If any infra PRs land after freeze, add `override/release` and tag me.

liam: Quick note: we'll do a canary config with reduced batch sizes in APAC for first 10m to test latency tail. Config snippet: `{"batch_max_tokens":64, "kv_cache_prefetch":true}`

emma: If all agree, I'll mark the release calendar and add the `release/v2.16.2` ticket with the schedule and owners. Please thumbs-up if OK. :thumbsup:

raj: 👍

sophie: 👍

liam: 👍 (will follow up with infra PR for autoscaler override and prewarm job)

emma: Thanks — closing loop. I'll post final RFC + calendar invite tomorrow.
